format: html

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(DT)


prizes <- read_csv("prizes_clean.csv")

inst_choices  <- sort(unique(na.omit(prizes$degree_institution)))
genre_choices <- sort(unique(na.omit(prizes$prize_genre)))
role_choices  <- sort(unique(na.omit(prizes$person_role)))
eth_choices   <- sort(unique(na.omit(prizes$ethnicity_macro)))
uk_choices    <- sort(unique(na.omit(prizes$uk_residence)))

ui <- navbarPage(
  "Prizes Explorer",

  tabPanel(
    "Dataset explorer",

    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        h4("Filters"),
        selectInput("inst_filter", "Degree institution:",
                    choices = c("All", inst_choices),
                    selected = "All"),
        selectInput("genre_filter", "Prize genre:",
                    choices = c("All", genre_choices),
                    selected = "All"),
        selectInput("role_filter", "Person role:",
                    choices = c("All", role_choices),
                    selected = "All"),
        selectInput("eth_filter", "Ethnicity macro:",
                    choices = c("All", eth_choices),
                    selected = "All")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Filtered data"),
        DTOutput("table_out"),
        br(),
        helpText("Use the filters on the left to explore the dataset.")
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Prizes by institution",

    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput("role_filter2", "Choose a role:",
                    choices = c("All", role_choices),
                    selected = "All"),
        sliderInput("top_n_inst", "Number of top institutions to show:",
                    min = 5, max = 30, value = 10, step = 1)
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Number of prizes by institution"),
        plotOutput("inst_plot"),
        br(),
        helpText("This plot shows which institutions appear most often in the prize data.")
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Ethnicity & UK residence",

    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput("uk_filter", "UK residence:",
                    choices = c("All", uk_choices),
                    selected = "All")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Ethnicity distribution"),
        plotOutput("eth_plot"),
        br(),
        helpText("This plot compares ethnicity groups, optionally within a UK residence category.")
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- prizes

    if (input$inst_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(degree_institution == input$inst_filter)
    }
    if (input$genre_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(prize_genre == input$genre_filter)
    }
    if (input$role_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(person_role == input$role_filter)
    }
    if (input$eth_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(ethnicity_macro == input$eth_filter)
    }

    df
  })

  output$table_out <- renderDT({
    datatable(
      filtered_data(),
      options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
    )
  })

  output$inst_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- prizes

    if (input$role_filter2 != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(person_role == input$role_filter2)
    }

    df_plot <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(degree_institution)) %>%
      count(degree_institution, sort = TRUE) %>%
      slice_head(n = input$top_n_inst)

    ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(degree_institution, n), y = n)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        x = "Degree institution",
        y = "Number of prizes",
        title = "Top institutions by number of prizes"
      )
  })

  output$eth_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- prizes

    if (input$uk_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(uk_residence == input$uk_filter)
    }

    df_plot <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(ethnicity_macro)) %>%
      count(ethnicity_macro)

    ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(ethnicity_macro, n), y = n)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        x = "Ethnicity (macro)",
        y = "Count",
        title = "Ethnicity distribution"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
